user.title: Connection type
user.description: Select a direct Modbus transport or an existing gateway.

existing_gateway.title: Existing S2000-PP gateway
existing_gateway.description: Select a loaded S2000-PP. Its existing Modbus connection will be shared.

gateway_child_model.title: Downstream equipment
gateway_child_model.description: Select a supported model behind this S2000-PP.

discovered_device.title: Configured Orion devices
discovered_device.description: Select one configured Orion address. Devices are never imported automatically.

io_mapping.title: Direct I/O mapping
io_mapping.description: Configure the device's direct Modbus I/O layout.

rtu_over_udp.title: Modbus RTU over UDP
rtu_over_udp.description: Configure raw Modbus RTU frames over UDP. The local UDP port is required by gateways that reply to a preconfigured static peer port.

gateway_context.title: S2000-PP gateway
gateway_context.description: Select an existing gateway context or add a new one.

gateway_new.title: New S2000-PP gateway
gateway_new.description: Give this physical gateway a stable name.

gateway_device.title: Downstream equipment
gateway_device.description: Configure the Orion and DPLS identity for the selected equipment.

mapping_source.title: Mapping source
mapping_source.description: Choose manual mapping or configuration-assisted mapping from configured S2000-PP tables.

manual_device.title: Orion device
manual_device.description: Enter the Orion address of the downstream equipment.

manual_object.title: Manual object mapping
manual_object.description: Map an Orion object to its configured S2000-PP table row.

manual_capability.title: Manual capability mapping
manual_capability.description: Map an equipment capability to its configured S2000-PP table row.

automatic_device.title: Configuration-assisted mapping
automatic_device.description: Find exact matching rows in the configured S2000-PP tables. This is not hardware discovery.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Modbus device.
error.invalid_rtu_over_udp_config: The Modbus RTU over UDP configuration is invalid.
error.invalid_io_mapping: The direct I/O mapping is invalid.
error.unsupported_gateway_transport: This equipment is not supported through the selected gateway transport.
error.unsupported_variant: This equipment variant is not supported.
error.invalid_equipment_mapping: The mapping does not match the selected equipment capabilities.
error.ambiguous_device_mapping: Several configured rows match this equipment. Refine the configuration or use manual mapping.
error.downstream_device_not_found: No exact configured mapping was found for this equipment.
error.cannot_read_gateway_configuration: Cannot read the configured S2000-PP tables.
error.gateway_unavailable: The selected S2000-PP is unavailable or not loaded.
error.unsupported_gateway_device: The selected equipment is not supported behind S2000-PP.
error.invalid_dynamic_address: The selected configured Orion address is invalid.
error.no_discovered_devices: No unconfigured Orion addresses are available. You can use manual mapping instead.

abort.no_devices_for_manufacturer: No equipment models are available for this manufacturer.
abort.no_loaded_gateways: Add and load a direct S2000-PP before adding downstream equipment.
